thread:
Priya Patel: Quick heads-up — Datadog partner kickoff tomorrow. We need a short obs integration playbook for the marketplace listing. Can someone pull the checklist together?
Ethan Li: I can sketch a checklist. Thinking: OTEL config, required spans, dashboard templates, alert examples, and SSO/provisioning notes.
Marcus Green: Add GPU & NVLink metrics + model-serving-specific traces (kv-cache hit/miss, seq-length, batching). Datadog wants explicit span names for routing/fallback.
Sabrina Ortiz: I'll draft dashboards if you share the key metrics. Prefer a single source-of-truth doc.
Priya Patel: Great — Alex (Datadog) will join the call at 10:30. @Alex can you confirm the mandatory fields for the marketplace integration?
Alex (Datadog): Yep — Datadog needs: OTLP ingester example, recommended processor pipeline, a dashboard JSON export, and a sample alert rule for tail-latency. Also a short integration blurb for our marketplace UI.
Ethan Li: Draft OTEL collector snippet (for our side) — should we suggest the agent or collector route? We usually recommend collector for cloud/private deployments.
Priya Patel: Collector recommended. Put both options but mark collector as preferred.
Ethan Li: Snippet I'm thinking to include in playbook:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: 
processors:
  batch:
  memory_limiter:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api: ${DATADOG_API_KEY}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Marcus Green: Looks good. Add env var for DD_SITE and an example for on-prem HSM-friendly keys. Also note sampling guidance for high-qps endpoints.
Sabrina Ortiz: For dashboards I'll start with 3 tabs: Overview (requests/latency/errors), Model Perf (token/sec, kv cache hit rate, sequence length dist), Infra (GPU util, memory, host network).
Priya Patel: Perfect. Also include recommended tags: customer_id, deployment_tier, model_version, route_name, request_priority. These map to billing and SLOs.
Alex (Datadog): One ask: include an example dashboard link we can import on our side and a short section on how to map Redwood trace/span attributes to Datadog trace tags.
dd-integ-bot: Reminder: partnership-kickoff call scheduled in 12h — calendar invite sent to channel.
Ethan Li: Action items: (1) I’ll push the OTEL + exporter snippet to the draft doc, (2) Sabrina will export a dashboard JSON, (3) Marcus to write trace/span naming convention + sampling.
Sabrina Ortiz: ETA for dashboard JSON: EOD tomorrow.
Marcus Green: I'll have the span naming guide + sampling notes by noon tomorrow.
Priya Patel: I'll stitch into a single playbook and send to Alex for Datadog review before the meeting. Thanks all. :pray: 
Alex (Datadog): Thanks — see you on the call. If possible, bring one sample trace (span dump) we can use for quick validation.
Ethan Li: Will attach a sanitized trace example to the doc before the call.
Priya Patel: Cool — closing loop here. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
